svg.aria-label: 14:00 · The reports. PatchBoard. Open source · a single file. Every week, security teams receive dozens of files listing which computers are out of date. PatchBoard takes them all in at once, shows the machines to fix and drafts the emails to warn the right people. PatchBoard: messy files become one dashboard, then an email goes out
